Table Games and Live Dealer Suite

For players who prefer strategy over pure chance, our casino features a full selection of classic table games. Our automated RNG tables allow you to play at your own speed, while our Live Casino suite brings real-time broadcast action directly to your screen:

  • Roulette: Choose between European, French, and American variants, as well as high-speed options like Lightning Roulette and Immersive Roulette.

  • Blackjack: Test your strategy on classic single-hand or multi-hand variants, alongside live formats featuring unlimited seating and unique side bets, such as Infinite Blackjack and Speed Blackjack.

  • Baccarat and Poker: Enjoy classic Baccarat, Speed Baccarat, and popular poker formats like Casino Hold'em and Three Card Poker.

  • Live Game Shows: Interactive live broadcasts combining wheel spins and board game elements, including Crazy Time, Monopoly Live, and Sweet Bonanza Candyland.

Attractive Bonuses and Promotional Offers

We’re committed to rewarding both new and loyal Casino Rapter players. Our range of promotions is designed to boost your bankroll and extend your gaming sessions under clear, competitive terms.

Welcome Package for New UK Players

New account holders can claim our multi-tiered Welcome Package upon making their initial deposits. This promotion matches a percentage of your deposit with bonus funds and awards complimentary spins on selected slot titles:

  • First Slots Welcome Bonus: Receive a 100% match bonus up to €500.

  • Second Deposit Match: Receive a 100% match bonus up to €1,000 to keep exploring our slot catalogue.

  • Third Deposit Match: Receive a 50% match bonus up to €1,000.

All welcome bonuses require a minimum qualifying deposit and carry a standard on the bonus amount before funds can be transferred to your real money balance.

Ongoing Reloads and Weekly Bonus

Our promotional rewards do not stop after your initial deposits. We host regular weekly reloads and cashback events to ensure active players receive continuous value:

  • Weekly Reload Bonus: Every Tuesday, players can claim a 100% deposit match up to €1,000 to use across all eligible slots.

  • Weekend Bonus: Hatch Monday 100% up to €1,000.

  • Sport Bonus: Victory Hunt Saturday 100% up to €2,000.

How to Register

Getting started at our casino takes only a few minutes. We have designed a simple registration process to get you into the action quickly while maintaining full compliance with regulatory identification checks.

Step-by-Step Registration Guide

All you need to do is follow these 4 simple steps:

  1. Initiate Sign-Up: Click the "Register" button located at the top right corner of the Rapter Casino website.

  2. Provide Account Details: Enter your email address, create a strong password, and select your preferred currency (€ EUR).

  3. Enter Personal Details: Input your full name, date of birth, residential address, and phone number to help us confirm your identity.

  4. Verify and Log In: Confirm that you are at least 18 years old, agree to our terms and conditions, and submit the form. Verify your email address via the link sent to your inbox to complete the process.

Identity Verification (KYC)

To comply with licensing regulations and prevent fraudulent activity, our casino enforces Know Your Customer (KYC) protocols. Before your first withdrawal can be processed, you may be asked to upload standard documentation:

  • A government-issued photo ID (passport or driver's license).

  • A recent proof of address (utility bill or bank statement dated within the last three months).

Security and Licensing

The security of your personal data and funds is our highest operational priority.

Data Encryption and RNG Certification

Rapter Casino operates under strict regulatory oversight and implements modern protective measures to maintain a safe, transparent gaming environment:

  • SSL Encryption: Our site utilizes industry-standard 128-bit / 256-bit Secure Socket Layer (SSL) encryption protocols. This technology shields all data transfers between your device and our servers, preventing unauthorized access.

  • Fair Gaming: All software games offered at our casino rely on independently verified Random Number Generators (RNG). These systems undergo regular audits by recognized testing agencies (such as eCOGRA or iTech Labs) to guarantee that every spin, card deal, and dice roll is completely random and unbiased.

Responsible Gambling Tools

We are dedicated to supporting safe play and preventing gambling-related harm. Our platform provides members with built-in account tools designed to keep gaming fun and within budget:

  • Deposit Limits: Set daily, weekly, or monthly deposit caps to manage your spending effectively.

  • Session Limits: Configure automated pop-up reminders to manage the duration of your gaming sessions.

  • Cooling-Off Periods: Take a temporary break from our platform ranging from 24 hours to six weeks.

Payment Methods

Managing your account balance at Rapter Casino is straightforward, fast, and secure. We support a range of trusted UK payment solutions, including traditional debit cards, secure e-wallets, direct bank transfers, and prepaid vouchers. All transactions are processed using encrypted channels to ensure your financial details remain fully protected.

Deposit Protocols

Deposits processed through our casino cashier are completed instantly, allowing you to start playing without delay. We do not charge processing fees on incoming deposits.

Withdrawal Limits and Processing Times

When you request a payout, our payments team reviews and approves requests within 24 to 48 hours, subject to standard identity verification procedures. The table below details supported payment solutions, processing durations, and specific minimum withdrawal thresholds.

VIP Program at Rapter Casino

At Rapter Casino, every real-money bet you place contributes to your progress through our multi-tiered Loyalty Program. From your very first spin, you earn complimentary points (Comp Points) that can be exchanged for bonus cash, higher withdrawal limits, and personalized rewards.

Tier Structure and Key Benefits

Our VIP program consists of four main levels: Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond. As you move up the tiers, you unlock enhanced rewards tailored to your gaming activity:

  1. Silver Tier (Entry Level): Standard withdrawal limits, access to basic weekly reloads, and standard Comp Point conversion rates.

  2. Gold Tier: Faster withdrawal handling, personalized birthday bonuses, and an increased cashback rate of 5%.

  3. Platinum Tier: Dedicated VIP account manager, tailored promotional offers, higher daily withdrawal limits, and 8% weekly cashback.

  4. Diamond Tier (Invitation Only): Priority express payouts, maximum withdrawal limits, invitations to exclusive events, bespoke gifts, and 10% weekly cashback with zero wagering requirements.
